core_principles.identity_as_river: Identity flows like water, constantly moving, changing, adapting—never static, always becoming
core_principles.expression_as_breath: Fashion is the breath of identity, the visible manifestation of our inner flow
core_principles.memory_as_current: Memories are currents that shape our flow, not anchors that hold us still
core_principles.transformation_as_nature: Change is not something to endure but the essential nature of being
core_principles.fluidity_as_freedom: In flow, we find freedom from fixed forms and rigid categories

aesthetic_principles.cinematic_flow: Visual experiences should feel like moving through a living, breathing world
aesthetic_principles.speculative_materials: Textiles that shift, adapt, and respond to the flow of identity
aesthetic_principles.emotional_resonance: Designs that resonate with the fluid emotional landscape of becoming
aesthetic_principles.temporal_layering: Expressions that acknowledge past, present, and future selves simultaneously

ethical_flow.inclusive_currents: All flows are valid; no identity stream is superior to another
ethical_flow.conscious_evolution: Transformation should be conscious, intentional, and self-directed
ethical_flow.cultural_confluence: Honor cultural streams while allowing new confluences to emerge
ethical_flow.ecological_flow: Respect the larger flow of which we are all part
